Senses.Explanation: The shrimp unable to jump from the dipper gives a compact image of confinement despite frantic motion. Yunmen’s proxy answer and Shuangquan’s replies establish the saying, while senior monk Ying uses it in an exchange with Faju Yiyu; the image does not assert a zoological claim.
